criteria.name: Présence du formulaire NDA dans Avec Standex
criteria.observed: Confidentiality checkbox opens the seven-field NDA form in the level review.

criteria.name: Secteur automatique pour une application automobile
criteria.observed: Automotive input reaches the identity endpoint and populates Automotive. Real Claude availability/output must be rechecked after publication.

criteria.name: Nom automatique du projet niveau
criteria.observed: Generated title is accepted and forwarded to the level journey callback. Real provider and published header must be rechecked.

criteria.name: Validation du formulaire incomplet
criteria.observed: Incomplete level submission displays the missing industry/contact/consent requirements instead of submitting.

criteria.name: Blocage sans NDA en vigueur
criteria.observed: Unsigned NDA remains requested, with explicit signed-proof warning and no confidential submission. NDA/consent guards pass in nda-optional and level-dossier tests.

criteria.name: Génération du NDA non signé
criteria.observed: Preview then download produced a valid unsigned DOCX. All seven fictitious values found in word/document.xml; no XML signature added. Template preservation tests pass.

criteria.name: Préparation de la fiche NDA
criteria.observed: NDA synchronization/permission tests pass. Creating a new server stub with this branch requires deployment and an authenticated test session.

criteria.name: Consentement obligatoire avec dossier complet
criteria.observed: The consent-bound level snapshot is required; technical changes require renewed consent (level-dossier tests).

criteria.name: Affectation commerciale France/Paris/Automobile
criteria.observed: Territory/industry tests pass. The actual France/Paris/Automotive assignment and selected city must be verified against deployed configuration.

criteria.name: Soumission réelle du dossier niveau non confidentiel
criteria.observed: Level snapshot and submission boundary pass. No new project was sent to the production database from this branch.

criteria.name: Proposition de rendez-vous après envoi
criteria.observed: Unconfigured calendar shows a truthful not-connected message. An existing booking URL remains supported. The published post-submit flow needs retest.

criteria.name: Navigation et sélection de créneau
criteria.observed: Week/day/slot selection and confirmation pass with VITE_BOOKING_PROVIDER=demo. This proves calendar UI only, not live availability.

criteria.name: Réservation et invitation réelles
criteria.observed: Graph availability/event tests pass with simulated responses. Standex IT must activate the real provider; no real meeting/invitation was created.

criteria.name: Projet visible dans Mon espace après envoi
criteria.observed: Cannot confirm the new branch in Mon espace before a real post-deployment submission.

criteria.name: Reprise de la version envoyée
criteria.observed: Level context, raw thresholds, cable and family survive the DTO round trip. Real customer-space restoration/version 2 needs deployment.

criteria.name: Secteur automatique application médicale
criteria.observed: Dialysis input reaches the identity endpoint and populates Medical. Real provider output remains pending.

criteria.name: Nom automatique sur le parcours direct
criteria.observed: Medical level review accepts and forwards a concise generated title. Authenticated isolated route needs a published retest.

criteria.name: Titre du dossier après retrait du NDA et envoi
criteria.observed: An existing masked stub is renamed to the consented current title before revision submission; a refused rename prevents submission. Real database/list display needs retest.

criteria.name: Renommage manuel et navigation
criteria.observed: Manual project rename persists through configuration/result navigation; it is marked as user-authored.

criteria.name: Conversion pourcentage vers cm
criteria.observed: Decimal cm/percent conversion and exact heights pass in level-journey, level-percent-intake and level-cm-wall tests.

criteria.name: Seuil de configuration hors plage
criteria.observed: Out-of-range/empty/nonnumeric configuration edits preserve the prior valid value and display feedback.

criteria.name: Détection niveau bas aux deux extrêmes
criteria.observed: Low-level monitor active/contact closed with empty tank; inactive/open with full tank. Illustration only.

criteria.name: Animation lancer/pause
criteria.observed: Start changes the liquid level; Pause stops it. WebGL tank, stem and float render on desktop.

criteria.name: Câble standard et terminaison
criteria.observed: 100 cm standard cable and bare leads appear unchanged in With Standex and the exported project PDF.

criteria.name: Longueur de câble négative
criteria.observed: Negative custom length blocks Continue; component cases also cover zero and nonnumeric input.

criteria.name: Contournement par navigation de la longueur invalide
criteria.observed: Top-step navigation can no longer bypass an invalid custom cable length; it stays on Result with the error.

criteria.name: Retour câble à Je ne sais pas
criteria.observed: Explicitly choosing unknown clears invalid cable state and permits the review without retaining the bad length.

criteria.name: Correction température et maintien du seuil

criteria.name: Coordonnées conservées après modification technique
criteria.observed: Contact name and email survive a return to the questionnaire, temperature edit and review.
